name: Upper trapezius
origin: External occipital protuberance, medial superior nuchal line and nuchal ligament
insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle
action: Scapular elevation and upward rotation; ipsilateral neck side-bending and contralateral rotation

name: Middle trapezius
origin: Spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of C7–T3
insertion: Medial acromion and superior crest of the scapular spine
action: Scapular retraction (medial glide)

name: Lower trapezius
origin: Spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of T4–T12
insertion: Medial end (root) of the scapular spine
action: Scapular depression and upward rotation (inferomedial glide)

name: Levator scapulae
origin: Transverse processes of C1–C4
insertion: Medial border of the scapula, from superior angle to root of the spine
action: Scapular elevation and downward rotation

name: Splenius capitis
origin: Lower nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7–T3
insertion: Mastoid process and lateral third of the superior nuchal line
action: Bilateral: head and neck extension; unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and side-bending

name: Splenius cervicis
origin: Spinous processes of T3–T6
insertion: Posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of C1–C3
action: Bilateral: neck extension; unilateral: ipsilateral neck rotation and side-bending

name: Sternocleidomastoid
origin: Manubrium of the sternum (sternal head) and medial third of the clavicle (clavicular head)
insertion: Lateral surface of the mastoid process and lateral half of the superior nuchal line
action: Unilateral: ipsilateral side-bending and contralateral rotation; bilateral: neck flexion, accessory inspiration

name: Rhomboid major
origin: Spinous processes of T2–T5
insertion: Medial border of the scapula, from root of the spine to the inferior angle
action: Scapular retraction, elevation and downward rotation

name: Rhomboid minor
origin: Lower nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7–T1
insertion: Medial border of the scapula at the root of the spine
action: Scapular retraction, elevation and downward rotation

name: Serratus anterior
origin: External surfaces of ribs 1–8 (or 9)
insertion: Costal (anterior) surface of the medial border of the scapula
action: Scapular protraction and upward rotation; holds the scapula against the thoracic wall

name: Pectoralis major
origin: Medial half of clavicle, sternum, upper 6 costal cartilages and external oblique aponeurosis
insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus
action: Shoulder adduction, medial rotation and flexion

name: Pectoralis minor
origin: Ribs 3–5 near their costal cartilages
insertion: Coracoid process of the scapula
action: Draws the scapula anteroinferiorly (depression/protraction); accessory inspiration

name: Deltoid
origin: Lateral third of the clavicle, acromion and spine of the scapula
insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus
action: Anterior: flexion & medial rotation; middle: abduction; posterior: extension & lateral rotation of the shoulder

name: Supraspinatus
origin: Supraspinous fossa of the scapula
insertion: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Initiates shoulder abduction (first ~15°); stabilises the humeral head

name: Infraspinatus
origin: Infraspinous fossa of the scapula
insertion: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder lateral rotation; stabilises the humeral head

name: Teres minor
origin: Upper two-thirds of the lateral border of the scapula
insertion: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder lateral rotation; stabilises the humeral head

name: Subscapularis
origin: Subscapular fossa of the scapula
insertion: Lesser tubercle of the humerus
action: Shoulder medial rotation; stabilises the humeral head

name: Biceps brachii
origin: Short head: tip of the coracoid process; long head: supraglenoid tubercle
insertion: Radial tuberosity and bicipital aponeurosis
action: Elbow flexion and forearm supination (assists shoulder flexion)

name: Brachialis
origin: Distal half of the anterior humerus
insertion: Coronoid process and tuberosity of the ulna
action: Elbow flexion in all forearm positions (the 'workhorse' flexor)

name: Coracobrachialis
origin: Tip of the coracoid process of the scapula
insertion: Medial surface of the humerus, middle third
action: Shoulder flexion and adduction

name: Triceps brachii
origin: Long head: infraglenoid tubercle; lateral and medial heads: posterior humerus
insertion: Olecranon process of the ulna
action: Elbow extension (long head also extends the shoulder)

name: Brachioradialis
origin: Proximal two-thirds of the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus
insertion: Lateral surface of the distal radius (just above the styloid process)
action: Elbow flexion, strongest with the forearm in mid-prone (neutral)

name: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
origin: Lateral epicondyle of the humerus (common extensor origin)
insertion: Dorsal base of the 3rd metacarpal
action: Wrist extension and radial deviation

name: Extensor carpi ulnaris
origin: Lateral epicondyle (common extensor origin) and posterior border of the ulna
insertion: Base of the 5th metacarpal (medial/dorsal side)
action: Wrist extension and ulnar deviation

name: Extensor carpi radialis longus
origin: Distal third of the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus
insertion: Dorsal base of the 2nd metacarpal
action: Wrist extension and radial deviation

name: Flexor carpi radialis
origin: Medial epicondyle of the humerus (common flexor origin)
insertion: Palmar base of the 2nd (and 3rd) metacarpal
action: Wrist flexion and radial deviation

name: Flexor carpi ulnaris
origin: Humeral head: medial epicondyle; ulnar head: olecranon and posterior border of ulna
insertion: Pisiform, hook of the hamate and base of the 5th metacarpal
action: Wrist flexion and ulnar deviation

name: Quadratus lumborum
origin: Posterior iliac crest and iliolumbar ligament
insertion: Inferior border of the 12th rib and transverse processes of L1–L4
action: Unilateral: ipsilateral trunk side-bending (hip hiking); bilateral: lumbar extension; fixes 12th rib in inspiration

name: Psoas major
origin: Sides of T12–L5 vertebral bodies and discs, and transverse processes of L1–L5
insertion: Lesser trochanter of the femur (common iliopsoas tendon)
action: Hip flexion; stabilises the hip joint

name: Iliacus
origin: Iliac fossa (also iliac crest, sacral ala and anterior sacroiliac ligaments)
insertion: Lesser trochanter of the femur (common iliopsoas tendon)
action: Hip flexion; stabilises the hip joint

name: Gluteus medius
origin: Outer ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines
insertion: Lateral surface of the greater trochanter
action: Hip abduction and medial rotation (anterior fibres); stabilises the pelvis in single-leg stance

name: Gluteus minimus
origin: Outer ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines
insertion: Anterior surface of the greater trochanter
action: Hip abduction and medial rotation; stabilises the pelvis

name: Gluteus maximus
origin: Posterior ilium (behind posterior gluteal line), dorsal sacrum and coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, thoracolumbar fascia
insertion: Iliotibial tract and gluteal tuberosity of the femur
action: Hip extension and lateral rotation

name: Tensor fasciae latae
origin: Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and anterior outer iliac crest
insertion: Iliotibial tract → lateral condyle of the tibia (Gerdy's tubercle)
action: Hip flexion, abduction and medial rotation; tenses the iliotibial band

name: Piriformis
origin: Anterior (pelvic) surface of the sacrum
insertion: Superior border (apex) of the greater trochanter
action: Hip lateral rotation of the extended hip; abducts the flexed hip

name: Biceps femoris
origin: Long head: ischial tuberosity; short head: lateral lip of the linea aspera
insertion: Head of the fibula
action: Knee flexion and lateral rotation of the flexed knee; long head extends the hip

name: Semitendinosus
origin: Ischial tuberosity
insertion: Superior medial surface of the tibia (pes anserinus)
action: Knee flexion and medial rotation of the flexed knee; hip extension

name: Semimembranosus
origin: Ischial tuberosity
insertion: Posterior surface of the medial tibial condyle
action: Knee flexion and medial rotation of the flexed knee; hip extension

name: Adductor magnus
origin: Inferior pubic ramus, ischial ramus and ischial tuberosity
insertion: Gluteal tuberosity, linea aspera, medial supracondylar line and adductor tubercle
action: Hip adduction; adductor part flexes, hamstring part extends the hip

name: Adductor longus
origin: Body of the pubis, just below the pubic tubercle
insertion: Middle third of the linea aspera
action: Hip adduction (assists hip flexion)

name: Adductor brevis
origin: Body and inferior ramus of the pubis
insertion: Pectineal line and proximal linea aspera
action: Hip adduction (assists hip flexion)

name: Rectus femoris
origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine (AIIS) and ilium just above the acetabulum
insertion: Tibial tuberosity via the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament
action: Knee extension and hip flexion

name: Vastus lateralis
origin: Greater trochanter and lateral lip of the linea aspera
insertion: Tibial tuberosity via the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament
action: Knee extension

name: Vastus medialis
origin: Intertrochanteric line and medial lip of the linea aspera
insertion: Tibial tuberosity via the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament
action: Knee extension; medial stabilisation of the patella (VMO)

name: Vastus intermedius
origin: Anterior and lateral surfaces of the femoral shaft
insertion: Tibial tuberosity via the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament
action: Knee extension

name: Gastrocnemius
origin: Lateral head: lateral femoral condyle; medial head: popliteal surface above the medial condyle
insertion: Calcaneal tuberosity via the calcaneal (Achilles) tendon
action: Ankle plantarflexion and knee flexion

name: Soleus
origin: Soleal line and medial border of the tibia, head and upper posterior fibula
insertion: Calcaneal tuberosity via the calcaneal (Achilles) tendon
action: Ankle plantarflexion (effective even with the knee flexed)

name: Tibialis posterior
origin: Posterior tibia, posterior fibula and interosseous membrane
insertion: Navicular tuberosity, cuneiforms, cuboid and bases of metatarsals 2–4
action: Foot inversion and plantarflexion; supports the medial longitudinal arch

name: Tibialis anterior
origin: Lateral condyle and upper lateral surface of the tibia, interosseous membrane
insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of the 1st metatarsal (medial/plantar side)
action: Ankle dorsiflexion and foot inversion

name: Fibularis longus
origin: Head and upper two-thirds of the lateral fibula
insertion: Lateral side of the medial cuneiform and base of the 1st metatarsal (via the sole)
action: Foot eversion and plantarflexion; supports the transverse arch

name: Fibularis brevis
origin: Lower two-thirds of the lateral fibula
insertion: Tuberosity on the lateral base of the 5th metatarsal
action: Foot eversion (weak plantarflexion)

name: Fibularis tertius
origin: Distal third of the anterior fibula (and interosseous membrane)
insertion: Dorsal surface of the base of the 5th metatarsal
action: Ankle dorsiflexion and foot eversion
